communication_loss.name: Motor lost communication (0xD)
communication_loss.meaning: A motor reported a communication fault. The message alone does not tell us why.
communication_loss.handling: The run pauses while the robot tries a short recovery on that motor. It resumes only after feedback and position checks pass. Otherwise, the run ends and the queue pauses for the operator.

feedback_timeout.name: Motor did not reply
feedback_timeout.meaning: The controller did not receive an expected motor reply. This is different from a motor reporting 0xD.
feedback_timeout.handling: The controller retries within its limits. If required feedback is still missing, the run ends and the queue pauses. Missing replies alone do not trigger a motor reset.

joint_timeout.name: Joint did not reach its target
joint_timeout.meaning: A joint did not reach the requested angle in time. This does not tell us whether something blocked it.
joint_timeout.handling: Motion stops at the measured position. If motor feedback is fresh and healthy, the model receives the error and new observations so it can choose a smaller move or another approach. The same run and countdown continue. A motor fault, unsafe hold, Stop or time limit still ends recovery.

gripper_delta.name: Gripper move too large
gripper_delta.meaning: The command asked the gripper to change its opening too much in one step.
gripper_delta.handling: The move is rejected. If caught during execution, the current cleanup ends the run and requests both arms off. The command needs smaller gripper steps.

servo_fault.name: Motor fault
servo_fault.meaning: A motor reported another fault, such as temperature, voltage or overload, or an unexpected state.
servo_fault.handling: The run stops and the queue pauses. Healthy motors continue holding where possible. The operator must inspect the fault; the robot does not automatically reset it.

time_limit.name: Run time expired
time_limit.meaning: The run used all of its selected time.
time_limit.handling: The run ends as a failure. Motion is cancelled, and the robot attempts to park and turn the motors off if the controller is healthy.

recording.name: Recording problem
recording.meaning: Some images or the recording could not be saved. This alone does not mean a motor failed.
recording.handling: The recording error is saved separately and does not reset motors. If the model also loses images it needs, its run may end.

execution.name: Other run failure
execution.meaning: The run failed, but the saved evidence does not identify one of the causes above.
execution.handling: The operator checks the recorded error and motor state before restarting. The word “FAULT” alone does not tell us whether the motors are off.
